prompt: Who is the most recent living NBA player to score 60 or more points in a regular-season game and be inducted into the Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame?
answer: **Carmelo Anthony**. He scored **62 points** for the New York Knicks against the Charlotte Bobcats on **January 24, 2014**, and was inducted into the **Naismith Memorial Basketball Hall of Fame as part of the Class of 2025**.
